items.html: And it is now found that these discernments are there in this manner: for innermost of all are the two first sections of NHY of Atik, and over them clothed the two middle sections of his Netzach and Hod, upon the two first sections mentioned. But over his Yesod there was no other discernment of Atik to clothe it. And over them, Chesed and Gevura of Arich clothed the two middle sections of NH of Atik. And the two upper thirds of Tifferet of Arich, down to the Tabur, clothed the Yesod of Atik that stands within, down to the chest; and over them, NH of Arich clothed Chesed and Gevura of Arich. And the lower third of Tifferet of Arich clothed the two upper thirds of Tifferet of AA itself. And afterward, the Yesod of AA clothed this lower third of Tifferet. And afterward, the crown of the Yesod, which is the Malchut of Arich, clothed over the Yesod of Arich. Thus the ascent and inclusion of Atik and Arich, of them within one another, has been explained.
